messages:
Maya (CS): OrbitX just filed an intake — they want to onboard a domain-specific 'telemetry-summarizer' for satellite telemetry. Key asks: deterministic outputs for audits, FIPS KMS/HSM support for signing summaries, on-prem/private option for export controls, and strict eval thresholds (precision@10 >= 0.92, p95 latency <= 180ms). They're on a growth plan with renewal in Q4; CS flagged renewal risk if onboarding stalls. Link to ticket: http://internal/tickets/ORBT-4921

Raj (ML Eng): Quick clarifying q's — which model size are they comfortable with (7B vs 13B)? Any constraints on quantization/FP? Also need to confirm whether their "deterministic" requirement means temperature=0 + top_p low + fixed seed, or something stricter (exact token-for-token reproducibility).

Maya (CS): They prefer smaller footprint initially — leaning 7B. They've offered ~5k labeled anomaly examples + ~20k unlabeled logs for transfer and eval. Deterministic: they want identical output across identical inputs (for audits) — so reproducibility is required, not just low diversity. They also asked for a way to cryptographically sign each summary record with their HSM.

Oliver (PM): Proposed path: 1) Baseline on Redwood-7b-v2-int8 in a Dedicated canary; 2) Run eval harness with their labeled set; 3) If stable, offer Private (VPC/on-prem) with KMS/HSM integration. Note on reproducibility: set temperature=0, top_p=0.1, disable sampling, and pin tokenizer / prompt templates. We don't have beam search guarantee for all model families so need to confirm stability.

Tasha (Solutions): I'll prepare enablement runbook and capture the safety checklist. Immediate items: model card, prompt templates, data retention & purge policy, and a 'no-geolocation hallucination' guardrail. Also need details on their signing workflow (what format, expected fields). I'll schedule a 30m SRE + CS + ML sync with OrbitX. :calendar:

Raj (ML Eng): Runtime notes — our serving runtime can pin seeds for deterministic runs, but some kernels/quantized paths can introduce nondeterminism across hardware. For Dedicated we can control the environment; for Private (on-prem) even better. HSM integration: we don't yet support writing signed artifacts directly with a customer's external HSM from Hosted/Dedicated. Private deployments can mount their KMS/HSM. For canary we can mock signing with a test key and validate signature flow.

Maya (CS): Renewal ops — I'll ask Sales to pause escalation if we commit to a canary start this week. If canary completes and we have a workplan for Private by EOW, renewal risk reduces.

Raj (ML Eng): I'll own the eval harness. Requesting: labeled set + exact scoring script or acceptance criteria, inference prompt templates, and a sample of edge-case logs that previously triggered false positives. ETA: baseline run in 3 business days, canary pipeline within 5 business days given dedicated slot.

Tasha (Solutions): Scheduling note: OrbitX wants CSV summaries delivered via webhook and each record signed (detached signature). For the mock canary I'll create a webhook consumer that verifies signatures and simulates HSM. I'll upload the runbook to the intake ticket.

Oliver (PM): Suggested eval metrics: precision@10, recall@10, false-positive-rate on anomalies, response stability (bitwise-identical outputs for repeated inputs), p95 latency, tokens per request (cost estimate). Also include a human-in-the-loop verification step for first 500 summaries.

Maya (CS): Capturing action items: (1) Raj: build eval harness + run baseline (2) Tasha: runbook + schedule SRE sync (3) Oliver: coordinate Dedicated slot + cost targets (4) Maya: coordinate sales & pause renewal escalation. I'll update ORBT-4921 and ping Sales. :ballot_box_with_check:

onboard-bot: Intake ORBT-4921 updated — added participants, uploaded initial artifacts, and set status to "canary-scheduled".

Raj (ML Eng): One more: please include an example prompt + expected output for reproducibility testing. Prefer a small set of deterministic unit tests we can run in CI.

Maya (CS): Will add sample prompts and a 50-case reproducibility suite to the ticket by EOD. Thanks all.
